subject: FT.CREATE and FT.SEARCH documentation updated (#1495)
reason: The change edits only src/commands/ft.create.json and ft.search.json, documentation metadata files describing command syntax (FILTER, FLOAT16/BFLOAT16, SCORER, WITHSCORES). These files are not referenced by the CMake build, build.sh, or any source file, so they are not compiled into or loaded by the module; command parsing and replies come from the untouched ft_create_parser/ft_search_parser C++ code. The built module is behaviorally identical at the change and its parent, so there is no runtime path to test and no scenario is needed.
